text:
maria: Quick sync — final preflight for marketplace launch next Wed. Need confirmations: press embargo, blog live time, marketplace listing gating, SI onboarding + hardware badge availability.

david: Can we stagger regions? EU first 09:00 CET, NA at 13:00 ET, APAC delayed 48h. Reduces outage risk. @kevin? :thinking:

kevin (Cloud Partner): EU + NA slots ok. Marketplace listing needs our final logo pack by EOD Tuesday. I'll upload once I have it.

ash: Blog draft is ready, waiting on quotes from hardware partners. I can publish at the scheduled times. Send me the final quote by 5pm PDT.

zara: SI integration test failed on auth flow — Oliver's team looking. If not fixed by Tue midnight UTC, we'll need to mark SI as 'soft launch' and block orchestration sync.

oliver (SI PM): Looking into it. Root cause: client cert rotation mismatch. We have a patch queued for Tue 02:00 UTC. ETA to QA 06:00 UTC.

emma (Press): Press embargo window requested: Tue 08:00 PT (blogs live) -> Wed 13:00 ET (NA launch). Press pack link: https://redwood.com/press/marketplace-pack. Need final product screenshots + quotes.

maria: Action list:
• @kevin upload logos by Tue EOD
• @ash publish blog at Tue 08:00 PT
• @emma confirm embargo recipients
• @oliver confirm SI patch deployed by Tue 06:00 UTC
• @zara toggle soft-launch flag if SI not green by Tue 07:00 UTC

Also need hardware partner badge PNG @kevin — partners require 300x100 + SVG.

david: I'll coordinate region cutover runbook. Can we do a brief w/ops Tue 09:00 PT? If so I will send calendar invite.

kevin (Cloud Partner): Badge assets attached in drive: https://drive.google.com/xxx — will update with SVG tonight.

partner-bot: Reminder: checklist item 'marketplace-legal-ok' completed by 5012345600.

maria: Thanks. If anyone sees blockers, ping here. Otherwise we'll roll with the staged plan. :rocket:
